biotools.summary: Endo-PairGS is a framework for dynamic 3D scene reconstruction in endoscopic data, utilizing aligned point cloud pairs to initialize a 4D Gaussian Splatting model. It aims to improve reconstruction in challenging environments involving deformable tissues and occlusions.
biotools.name: Endo-PairGS: Pair Priors for Dynamic Endoscopic Scene Reconstruction
